{{Top|leg}}
[[File:Snoova.jpg|thumb|right|Snoova wore a monocle ocular enhancer over his right eye and later had the device permanently installed as a cybernetic prosthesis.]]
A '''monocle ocular enhancer''' was a device worn like an [[Eye patch/Legends|eye patch]] over an [[Eye/Legends|eye]] to afford the user increased visual acuity,<ref name="SaV">[[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|''Scum and Villainy'']]</ref> better low-light vision,<ref name="SOTESB">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> and the ability to [[Infrared receptor|see]] in the [[Infrared/Legends|infrared]] spectrum.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Snoova]] wore such equipment;<ref name="SOTESB" /> after he lost an eye while pursuing a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]], he had a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] implant installed in his right eye socket and attached the ocular enhancer to it, making it a permanent part of his gear.<ref name="SaV" />
